title: Step-By-Step Directions From a Binary Tree Node to Another
goal: Describe the shortest route between two tree nodes using U L and R.
strategy: Root-to-node paths share their route through the lowest common ancestor. Remove that common prefix, go up for the remaining start path, then follow the remaining destination path.
